name: draft-v2 (2026-10-25, owner feedback: exact sync, the opening fly-in, smoothness, glances, stock at 4:3)

segments.title: 1997 vs 2026: THE T05 OPENING
segments.caption: Same scripted fly-in, same sim second on both sides   |   600 m: hills pop in at a hard edge   |   2300 m, morphing terrain

segments.title: SAME ROUTE. SAME CAR. SAME 1997 TICK.
segments.caption: Both sides start on the first moment the car moves; the MPH counters agree because the sim is the 1997 one\N{\fs28}counters = each recording's own telemetry (screen capture costs ~25 % of the frame rate)

segments.title: SMOOTHNESS: 20 FPS vs THE TICK, DRAWN AT DISPLAY RATE
segments.caption: A fast weave: same 41.667 ms physics, every frame in between interpolated

segments.title: THE JUMP, AS IN 1997
segments.caption: Canyon ramp: take-off 49.9 vs 50.0 m/s, apex 10.0 m as retail; the nose-dive off the lip eased 9 %

segments.title: THE FAR EDGE FADES INTO THE SKY
segments.caption: The last 25 % of the 2300 m view feathers to transparent instead of a hard wall

segments.title: TERRAIN THAT MORPHS INSTEAD OF POPPING
segments.caption: Level-of-detail splits blend in over 25 % of their ring; shading steps 16 -> 32-40 grey levels

segments.title: LOOK AROUND WHILE YOU DRIVE
segments.caption: Glance left, right and back (keys, pad or opentrack head tracking) - same drive, same moment

segments.title: HEAD TRACKING
segments.caption: opentrack: look into the corner, check the mirror, glance back - the glance keys still win when held

segments.title: A REAR MIRROR THAT SEES
segments.caption: Mirror far clip 100 m -> 1000 m, drawn with the main view's terrain art (cost 1.2 %)

segments.title: LAN NIGHT, FIXED
notes: JOINERS SPAWN\N27 M FROM THE HOST

segments.title: FIGHT
segments.caption: Computer cars in every arena, respawning in 5 s  -  wheel force feedback on every shot, hit and landing

segments.title: WHEEL FORCE FEEDBACK, REBUILT
